title: CAP Theorem
subtitle: When the network splits, you choose between correct and available
motto: Partitions are not optional, so choose how you fail
coreAddition: CP versus AP during a partition
keyInsight: Because partitions will happen, the real choice is whether the small side refuses requests or answers from data that may be stale.

decisions.title: One split with a small side, not a general model
decisions.description: The sim splits three replicas into a majority and a minority so the CP and AP outcomes are easy to read as percentages of users.
decisions.alternatives: A model with arbitrary partitions is more general but hides the simple fact that one side loses a majority.

decisions.title: End on a per-feature choice
decisions.description: The trade-off frame classifies part of the traffic as needing consistency, since real systems rarely pick one letter for everything.
decisions.alternatives: Stopping at CP versus AP would leave learners believing a whole system must pick a side.
